title: Asset can be permanently deleted in one tap with no confirmation, reason or record
status: Fixed locally - awaiting verification (9 Nov 2026, uix/screen-verification, uncommitted)
evidence: src/routes/_authenticated/assets.tsx:49 (remove filters the asset out and saves); :110 (Delete button, no confirmation); found by 111-screen audit, verified by coordinator; FIX: Delete removed (assets.tsx edit form now has Archive); src/lib/archive.ts archive/restore status + append-only archiveHistory (who=owner user id, when, why); src/components/ArchiveDialog.tsx confirmation with required reason; Archived assets view with Restore (assets.tsx); manual holdings Remove replaced by Archive/Restore (MarketPanel.tsx); preserve-records.ts writes archive-only changes onto the stored original; archived records stay in book value, depreciation, books and net worth
